properties.name: app.frontend-url
properties.description: Base URL of the frontend application used in redirects and links.

properties.name: app.backend-url
properties.description: Base URL of the backend application used for payment callback links.

properties.name: app.mail.from
properties.description: Default sender email address for application emails.

properties.name: app.bootstrap-admin.enabled
properties.description: Enables automatic creation of a bootstrap admin account at startup.

properties.name: app.bootstrap-admin.name
properties.description: Display name of the bootstrap admin account.

properties.name: app.bootstrap-admin.email
properties.description: Email address of the bootstrap admin account.

properties.name: app.bootstrap-admin.password
properties.description: Password used when creating the bootstrap admin account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.enabled
properties.description: Enables seeding demo users and sample data at startup.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.password
properties.description: Shared password assigned to demo seed accounts.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.admin-name
properties.description: Display name of the seeded demo admin account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.admin-email
properties.description: Email address of the seeded demo admin account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.host-name
properties.description: Display name of the seeded demo host account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.host-email
properties.description: Email address of the seeded demo host account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.user-name
properties.description: Display name of the seeded demo user account.

properties.name: app.demo-seed.user-email
properties.description: Email address of the seeded demo user account.

properties.name: payment.sandbox.secret
properties.description: Shared secret used to sign and verify sandbox payment requests.

properties.name: payment.manual.bank.provider
properties.description: Display name of the bank used for manual bank transfer payments.

properties.name: payment.manual.bank.account-name
properties.description: Account holder name for manual bank transfer payments.

properties.name: payment.manual.bank.account-number
properties.description: Account number for manual bank transfer payments.

properties.name: payment.manual.wallet.provider
properties.description: Display name of the e-wallet provider used for manual wallet payments.

properties.name: payment.manual.wallet.account-name
properties.description: Account holder name for manual wallet payments.

properties.name: payment.manual.wallet.account-number
properties.description: Account number or identifier for manual wallet payments.
